verdict.rationale: Modal's pricing page says customers can transact through the AWS and GCP marketplaces to use committed spend on Modal. That is a first-party committed-spend billing path, but nothing shows Modal's own reserved-capacity or committed-use discount programme for sustained GPU capacity. missing for 10: a documented Modal reserved or committed-use discount for sustained GPU capacity, a capacity reservation or guarantee mechanism, discount terms or rates, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can lock in reserved or committed-use discounts for sustained GPU capacity

citations.quote: Transact through the AWS and GCP marketplace to use committed spend on Modal.
